# Euler Method

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Integrate dx/dt = 2 from x(0) = 1. Two explicit Euler steps of 0.5 s give x = 1, 2, 3; the rows of X Values correspond in order to the three Times.

## What this example demonstrates

Integrate dx/dt = 2 from x(0) = 1. Two explicit Euler steps of 0.5 s give x = 1, 2, 3; the rows of X Values correspond in order to the three Times.
